conviction_note: A pre-revenue biotech whose financial prints have moved it a median 0.96% (last two -0.96%, -0.48%). No new clinical data is due: the maintenance readout (9/22), the $575M raise (closed 9/28) and the SUNRISE oral Phase 3 start (10/14) are all public. What is left is a crowded short (21.4% of float), a stock 29% below its own $35 offering price and 23% down over 20 days, bid calls (skew -6.8), and LLY's bmo print on 10/29 inside the window, which could move it either way. That gives a slight upward lean (p_up 54) on a 5-point move: (2*0.54-1)*5 = +0.4. The per-finding sum (+0.7) is close to it and was not fitted to it. Web search budget ran out partway through the hunt (shared 200-call limit), so peer and LLY coverage is thinner than intended.
bar: Q3 2026 consensus EPS -$1.06, revenue $0.00 (24/7 Wall St, 2026-10-25, https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/25/why-viking-therapeutics-oral-obesity-strategy-will-be-a-make-or-break-focus-on-oct-28/). One source only, no company guide, so every finding is capped small. Q2 printed -$1.10 against -$1.21 (https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/nebenwerte/viking-therapeutics-stock-fell-3-07-percent-as-oral-trial-starts/70249351). The share count added in the 9/28 offering barely touches Q3 weighted-average shares, and interest income on about $500M of cash continues, so a small beat or an in-line print is likely. The number does not move this name; the call commentary does (VANQUISH readout timing, SUNRISE design, R&D cadence).
positioning_check: Short interest was 25,538,849 shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement (FINRA, published 10/26), 21.41% of float, 4.4 days to cover, down 1.5% from 25.92M (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/VKTX/short-interest). In August it was about 22.3-22.5M, about 19.3% of float (https://equibles.com/stocks/vktx/shortinterest), so it rose after the $258.75M 2.00% convertible notes due 2032 were issued, which is consistent with convertible-arbitrage hedging making up part of the short. Skew_25d is -6.77 vol points (calls bid over puts), put/call OI is 0.32, the baseline lean is 'upside paid', and the event-implied move is 6.46% with a 38% ATM spread (indicative only). Tape: -23.4% over 20 days, -5.3% over 5 days, 3% above the 52-week low, about 29% below the $35.00 offering price.

findings.finding: The Q3 balance sheet (9/30) will be the first to include the 9/28 offering's roughly $547.8M of net proceeds (9,035,714 shares at $35.00 plus $258.75M of 2.00% converts due 2032). Starting from $502.0M of cash at 6/30 less about $120-130M of Q3 burn (Q2 net loss $128M), pro forma cash is about $900M+. The company already said the raise funds operations into 2028, and the money is going into VANQUISH-1/2 (about 5,500 patients, fully enrolled) and SUNRISE (oral Phase 3, started 10/14), so the use is corroborated.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The raise itself cost about -11% in one session when it was announced (https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-viking-therapeutics-vktx-stock-down-11-19-today-17057/). The cash line on past prints has not moved the stock (median abs reaction 0.96%).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the dilution was priced in September. What the market does not yet have is a stated runway and burn guide on a balance sheet with about $900M, against a stock that now trades near cash plus little pipeline value (market cap about $3.3B at $28, https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/nebenwerte/viking-therapeutics-stock-fell-3-07-percent-as-oral-trial-starts/70249351). If it were fully priced, the stock would not sit 29% below a price institutions paid four weeks ago.
findings.independence: The 24/7 Wall St preview says the raise extends funding into 2028 (https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/10/25/why-viking-therapeutics-oral-obesity-strategy-will-be-a-make-or-break-focus-on-oct-28/).

findings.finding: The reported quarter has no revenue line. Consensus EPS is -$1.06 (one source) against Q2's actual -$1.10 on $115.8M of R&D. SUNRISE started 10/14, so its costs fall in Q4 rather than Q3. The share base added on 9/28 counts for only 2 days of Q3, and interest income continues on about $500M of cash, so the print is likely near or slightly better than the bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 beat -$1.21 with -$1.10 and the stock moved -0.96% (baseline; one source reports -4.14% the next day). The last seven print reactions: -0.96, -0.48, +6.8, +7.96, +0.3, -0.5, -6.09. The EPS line does not decide the move.
findings.why_not_priced: It does not need to be priced. A beat on a pre-revenue biotech's loss line has bought nothing in the last two prints.
findings.independence: Q2 actual vs consensus from a different source (https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/nebenwerte/viking-therapeutics-stock-fell-3-07-percent-as-oral-trial-starts/70249351).

findings.finding: The setup into a print with no new data is a crowded short with calls bid. Short interest is 21.41% of float (25.5M shares, 10/15 settlement, 4.4 days to cover). The stock fell from $40.85 on the 9/22 maintenance-data spike to $24.98 at the seal (-23% over 20 days), about 29% below the $35 offering, with skew -6.8 and put/call OI 0.32. A call that only restates the timelines (VANQUISH on track, SUNRISE enrolling, runway into 2028) gives shorts a reason to cover, and a share of that short is convertible-hedge supply rather than conviction.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The two large up reactions in the history (+7.96% on 10/22/2025, +6.8% on 2/11/2026) came at prints with pipeline commentary. On 9/22 the stock rose 35.7% on $1.6bn of turnover when maintenance data landed (https://stock.10jqka.com.cn/20260923/c680187154.shtml), which shows how sharply this short base can cover.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: calls are already bid (skew -6.8, lean 'upside paid'). The squeeze potential sits in the tails rather than in the median, and that is why the range here is wide while the point estimate is small. If the market had fully priced a relief move, the stock would not be 3% off its 52-week low with short interest still rising from August.
findings.independence: The October slide is attributed to financing overhang and competitive concerns, not new clinical news (https://www.quiverquant.com/news/Viking+Therapeutics+Slides+as+Financing+Overhang+and+Competitive+Concerns+Weigh+on+Sentiment). August short interest was about 19.3% of float (https://equibles.com/stocks/vktx/shortinterest).

findings.finding: Eli Lilly reports Q3 before the open on 2026-10-29, inside this window (sweep row). Canaccord has already cut its VKTX price target, citing pricing pressure across obesity drugs. If LLY's call reinforces GLP-1 price erosion, the read-through to a future entrant's economics is negative. Strong incretin demand would read the other way.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured history of VKTX reacting to LLY prints in this file. The sector beta is real but unquantified here.
findings.why_not_priced: LLY's print is unknown until 10/29 bmo. The pricing concern is partly in the 23% 20-day decline already. The sign is a coin flip and the finding is a proxy (macro-to-company transmission that no counterparty has confirmed), so it is filed small. The crowded short also argues against sizing a negative larger.
findings.independence: Shares this document with the bar and finding 1. The quiverquant piece cites 'competitive concerns' (https://www.quiverquant.com/news/Viking+Therapeutics+Slides+as+Financing+Overhang+and+Competitive+Concerns+Weigh+on+Sentiment).

findings.finding: The SUNRISE oral Phase 3 design is already public (10/14): two 68-week placebo-controlled trials of about 560 each, obesity and obesity with T2D, daily doses of 27.5/35/55 mg, built on Phase 2 VENTURE-Oral's up to 12.2% weight loss at 13 weeks. The oral maintenance arm (Part 2) started 10/6 and reads out in 2027. The call can add enrollment pace and VANQUISH topline timing; neither is sourced as new.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell 3.07% on 10/6, the day the oral maintenance arm started, and kept sliding after the 10/14 SUNRISE start. Pipeline-progress news has been sold this month.
findings.why_not_priced: Priced: it is in the wire. A VANQUISH topline date pulled forward would be new, but nothing sources it.

outside_window.finding: VANQUISH-1/2 subcutaneous Phase 3 toplines and the oral maintenance Part 2 results (2027) are the catalysts that really reprice VKTX. Both fall after the window.

lessons_applied: Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the raise funds the fully enrolled VANQUISH trials and the started SUNRISE program, so finding 1 stays a small positive at +0.3.
